economic_ownership_map.label: Cash and equivalents minus debt
economic_ownership_map.ownership_claim: Corporate net cash position per share
economic_ownership_map.evidence: Cash CAD 465.9M less debt CAD 474.0M at December 31, 2025 (ifrs-full companyfacts via 40-F FY2025)
economic_ownership_map.scenario_assumptions: FY2025 balance sheet net debt roughly flat; low case assumes working capital draw before FID.
economic_ownership_map.tax_and_realization_adjustments: Low case assumes working capital draw before Phoenix FID.
economic_ownership_map.falsifier: Owner cash, reinvestment economics, or competitive position remains below the low-case path for two reporting periods.

economic_ownership_map.label: Uranium prepayment and sale contracts at fair value
economic_ownership_map.ownership_claim: Marked uranium prepayment and sale contract portfolio
economic_ownership_map.evidence: Financial assets at fair value CAD 746.197M / 901.6M shares (ifrs-full:FinancialAssetsAtFairValue)
economic_ownership_map.scenario_assumptions: Marked portfolio; high case assumes uranium price uplift on contract marks.
economic_ownership_map.tax_and_realization_adjustments: High case assumes uranium price uplift on contract marks.
economic_ownership_map.falsifier: Owner cash, reinvestment economics, or competitive position remains below the low-case path for two reporting periods.

economic_ownership_map.label: Wheeler River Phoenix ISR project (probability-weighted NPV)
economic_ownership_map.ownership_claim: 95% interest in Phoenix ISR post-tax NPV after probability and timing discount
economic_ownership_map.evidence: Phoenix feasibility economics incorporated by reference in Form 40-F FY2025 (Exhibits 99.1-99.3 not in admitted evidence packet). Base applies P=0.55 and timing discount to ~95% project interest on adjusted post-tax NPV ~USD 1.48B (June 2023 FS, company disclosure) [Assumption].
economic_ownership_map.scenario_assumptions: Binary milestone: provincial permits and FID gate value.

probability_and_timing.timing_basis: Seven-year horizon; value recognized as FID/construction milestones advance, not as current owner cash.
probability_and_timing.probability_basis: Base case P=0.55 on Phoenix FID by 2028; low case P=0.25 with delay; high case P=0.75 with early FID.
probability_and_timing.remaining_capital_basis: Construction capex and equity raises before first production are charged in scenario payoffs, not as a separate additive row.

economic_ownership_map.tax_and_realization_adjustments: Binary milestone: provincial permits and FID gate value.
economic_ownership_map.falsifier: Phoenix ISR permits denied or FID pushed beyond 2029 without financing path.

economic_ownership_map.label: Wheeler River Gryphon conventional option
economic_ownership_map.ownership_claim: Follow-on Gryphon conventional mine option after Phoenix
economic_ownership_map.evidence: Gryphon PFS update economics incorporated by reference (40-F FY2025); base P=0.25 on ~95% of post-tax NPV ~USD 821M with deferral discount [Assumption].
economic_ownership_map.scenario_assumptions: Follow-on phase after Phoenix; zero in bear.

probability_and_timing.timing_basis: Deferred past Phoenix FID; no value in first five years in base case.
probability_and_timing.probability_basis: Base P=0.25; high P=0.45 if Phoenix funds Gryphon; low P=0.0 if shelved.
probability_and_timing.remaining_capital_basis: Gryphon capex not modeled separately; absorbed in consolidated scenario payoffs.

economic_ownership_map.tax_and_realization_adjustments: Zero in bear scenario; follows Phoenix success.
economic_ownership_map.falsifier: The next decision milestone fails, remaining capital rises materially, or the stated success probability no longer fits observable progress.

economic_ownership_map.label: Athabasca exploration portfolio, JVs, and equity-method investments
economic_ownership_map.ownership_claim: Regional exploration and JV interests outside Wheeler consolidated NPV
economic_ownership_map.evidence: Investments in associates CAD 4.832M; joint ventures CAD 19.450M; PP&E CAD 316.926M includes capitalized exploration (ifrs-full FY2025). Risked overlay excludes double-count with Wheeler NPV rows.
economic_ownership_map.scenario_assumptions: McClean Lake / Midwest / Murphy Lake interests plus regional exploration.

probability_and_timing.timing_basis: Long-dated option value; no near-term cash distributions modeled.
probability_and_timing.probability_basis: Low/base/high range reflects discovery and JV optionality, not producing cash.
probability_and_timing.remaining_capital_basis: Exploration burn continues until Phoenix construction funding closes.

economic_ownership_map.tax_and_realization_adjustments: Excludes double-count with Wheeler NPV rows.
economic_ownership_map.falsifier: The next decision milestone fails, remaining capital rises materially, or the stated success probability no longer fits observable progress.

failure_modes: growth projected without its capital cost
terminal value unsupported by a durable mechanism
method_route.decision_rule: Power Zones select the fitting economic method and eligible independent reviewers; they never choose the valuation answer or capital decision.

valuation.interpretation: value_per_share is withheld while any material additive component is unpriced; priced_components_per_share is the raw additive sum (may be negative). When complete, value_per_share applies a 0 floor (limited liability).

scenario_contract.rule: Cases must change cited causal operating, capital, probability, timing, or financing drivers—not only a terminal multiple.
